title: The product of the canonical derived inverse-limit projections
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme with its small pro-etale site and $d$ an adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. For a strict derived tower $M$, write $M_n$ and $t_n$ for its derived evaluations and transitions [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-limit]. Let $\mathrm{Rlim}$ and $p_n:\mathrm{Rlim}(M)\to M_n$ be the actual right-derived inverse-limit functor and projections [def-pur-completed-rlim-functor]. Whenever $\prod_n M_n$ exists, define the canonical Roos first arrow $r_M:\mathrm{Rlim}(M)\to\prod_n M_n$ as the product lift of the $p_n$. Thus its composite with the nth product projection is $p_n$. This definition makes no distinguished-triangle assertion.

lean.statement:
def completedRlimRoosProjection (T : Scheme.{t})
    {A : Type (t + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (M : DerivedCategory (reductionTowerCategory T
      (reductionModuleRing T (completedReductionCoefficient T d))))
    [HasProduct (completedTowerDerivedSequence T d M)] :
    (completedRlim T (completedReductionCoefficient T d)).obj M ⟶
      ∏ᶜ (completedTowerDerivedSequence T d M)
